# uptrace_opsgenie_channel (Resource)

Manages an Uptrace Opsgenie notification channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name = "My Organization"
}

resource "uptrace_project" "example" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.example.id
  name   = "api"
}

resource "uptrace_opsgenie_channel" "example" {
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
  name       = "alerts-opsgenie"
  priorities = ["high"]
  api_key    = "your-opsgenie-api-key"
  priority   = "P2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Opsgenie API key.
- `name` (String) Human-readable channel name.
- `priorities` (List of String) Alert priorities to match. Valid values: info, low, medium, high.
- `priority` (String) Opsgenie alert priority (P1–P5).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID this channel belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `api_provider` (String) Alert API that receives the alerts: opsgenie (the default), jsm (Jira Service Management), or custom.
- `condition` (String) Alert condition expression.
- `endpoint` (String) Alert API URL. Required when api_provider is custom; leave unset for opsgenie and jsm.
- `match_all` (Boolean) Match all monitors. If false, monitor_ids must be provided.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitor IDs to match when match_all is false. Omit to leave the links alone, as when monitors name the channel in their channel_ids; set [] to detach every monitor.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel ID.
- `status` (String) Channel status (delivering, paused, disabled, draft).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_opsgenie_channel.example 1:42
```
